projectDescription: A collection of quality-of-life SMAPI mods for Stardew Valley that automate foraging, manage inventory trash, enable Beach Farm sprinklers, and simplify the fishing mini-game.
keyFeatures: Auto Forager: automatically collects forageable items, seeds, fruits, moss, and more as the player walks nearby
Configurable forage radius with per-item and per-category toggle controls
Mod integrations for Bush Bloom, Custom Bush, Farm Type Manager, Wild Flowers Reimagined, SpaceCore, and GMCM
Auto Forager Content Pack system allowing any mod author to register custom forageable items
17 first-party content packs covering popular mod expansions (SVE, Cornucopia, Ridgeside Village, etc.)
Auto Trasher: automatically discards user-defined items on pickup with full reclaim history
Trash List management UI with scrollable item list and confirmation dialogs
Reclaim system recovers recently auto-trashed items at the vanilla trash reclamation price
Allow Beach Sprinklers: enables sprinkler functionality on the Beach Farm layout
Full Fishing Bar: resizes the fishing bobber bar up to 100% and optionally auto-hooks nibbling fish
Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) support across all mods for in-game configuration
Multilingual support: up to 12 locales across all mods
publicApiSurface: Auto Forager config.json: AutoForagingEnabled, ToggleForagerKeybind, UsePlayerMagnetism, ShakeDistance, FruitsReadyToShake, MaxInteractionsPerMove, RequireHoe, RequireToolMoss, RequirePan, IgnoreMushroomLogTrees, ForageArtifactSpots, ForageSeedSpots, ForageMushroomBoxes, ForageMushroomLogs, ForageTappers, ForagePanningSpots
Auto Forager ForageToggles: BushToggles, ForagingToggles, FruitTreeToggles, WildTreeToggles, FlowerGrassToggles (per-item dictionaries)
Auto Forager Content Pack schema: content.json with Category, Forageables[], FruitTrees[], WildTrees[], IgnoredItems[]
Auto Forager asset editing: custom fields HedgehogTechnologies.AutoForager.Forageable and HedgehogTechnologies.AutoForager.Category injected into Data/Objects, Data/FruitTrees, Data/WildTrees
Auto Trasher config.json: ToggleTrasherKeybind, OpenTrashMenuKeybind, AddTrashKeybind, ReclaimableItemCount, AllowAllItems, TrashList
Full Fishing Bar config.json: IsEnabled, OnlyCorkBobber, BarSizePercentageInt, ExceptBossFish, AutoHook
Allow Beach Sprinklers: zero-config, automatic on Beach Farm (farm layout #6)
Keybinds: Auto Forager toggle (LeftAlt+H / RightAlt+H), Auto Trasher toggle (LeftAlt+R / RightAlt+R), Trash Menu (LeftAlt+L / RightAlt+L), Quick-Add to Trash (LeftAlt+X / RightAlt+X)
